title: Integrated Review Path Qualification
failure_conditions: candidate or base identity changes after freeze
blind packet leaks proposer/reviewer/promotion anchor fields
evidence is not explicitly typed as untrusted data
promotion-authoritative routing skips R3 for any R2 disposition
R1-middle adds opinion or silently drops unknown material R2 fields
final authority is issued before required reviewer stages complete
construction_success: all deterministic integrated-path tests pass with zero provider LLM API calls
behavioral_success: fresh R2 and R3 reviews over the same frozen integrated packet complete, are evidence-grounded, and deterministic final adjudication does not contradict mandatory evidence
